editorial:
Imagine living on a quiet horse ranch in the middle of nowhere, only to notice something strange hovering in the clouds. That is the setup for this wild ride. You follow two siblings who run a horse training business after their father passes away. They soon realize a UFO is hiding in the sky above their valley. The vibe is tense and mysterious, mixing everyday life with something truly out of this world. You feel the dread building as they try to figure out what is up there and how to survive it.

The acting is top notch, especially the lead who brings humor and heart to a scary story. The action scenes are thrilling and the pacing keeps you on edge without rushing. On the downside, some parts move slowly and the plot can feel confusing at first. If you enjoy smart sci-fi with real scares, this is for you.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the UFO is actually a living creature that eats people and spits out objects. The siblings and their friend try to capture it on camera to prove it exists. During the showdown, the creature opens up like a giant eye and swallows several characters. The lead uses a well-trained horse to lure it, then triggers a giant balloon that pops and kills the creature. They finally get their shot, proving the truth to the world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves smart sci-fi horror with big scares.
